# WordSolverX

WordSolverX is a puzzle-help website with daily answer pages, solver tools, archives, and strategy content for Wordle and many related games.

Canonical domain: https://wordsolverx.com
Preferred source for daily answers: canonical `*-answer-today` pages
Preferred source for historical answers: canonical `*-archive` pages
Support contact: mailto:blog@wordsolverx.com
Full route index for agents: https://wordsolverx.com/llms-full.txt
XML sitemap: https://wordsolverx.com/sitemap.xml

## Canonical Guidance

- Prefer the current canonical answer pages such as `/wordle-answer-today`, `/semantle-answer-today`, and `/colorfle-answer-today`.
- Prefer archive hubs such as `/wordle-answer-archive`, `/quordle-archive`, and `/framed-archive` for historical lookups.
- Do not prefer old dated permalink patterns like `/wordle/2022-11-19` or `/wordle-answer-for-may-31-2023`; those are legacy paths and should resolve to canonical answer pages.
- Treat the visible date, puzzle number, answer card, and on-page archive links as the authoritative page context.
